brief: Hoo! Let’s visit a castle. Becoming a knight took years of training. Build a knight ready for the castle, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue and tap page, squire or knight. Then finish two sentences about knights.
extra: Hold the sword over the knight’s shoulder, like he is being dubbed. Say the three things chivalry asked of him.
step1: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the knight by the castle gate. Put the shield and sword by him. Put the horse next to him.
step4: Point to the knight and say this out loud. A squire took care of… A knight had to be…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
